## Current role

AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer at Pollux Motors, Dubai (April 2025 — present). Builds and
maintains production systems for automotive import/export operations: website, vehicle listings,
APIs, and internal tools; an AI customer-support chatbot connected to internal vehicle data;
n8n automations for lead collection, qualification, follow-up, and booking; face-recognition and
QR attendance tooling.

Previously: AI Engineer Intern at the Information Technology Institute (ITI), Fayoum, Egypt
(September — November 2023).

## Projects

- **AutoExport AI ERP / AutoSphere** — white-label, multi-tenant ERP for vehicle trading groups with inventory, CRM, quotations, finance, documents, reports, and permission-aware AI workflows. Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, RLS.
- **AI SmartChoice** — bilingual affiliate SaaS that scrapes Amazon products and generates AI verdicts, review summaries, pros/cons, scores, and price insights. Next.js 14, Supabase, Ollama, Python.
- **Local AI Desktop Assistant** — voice-activated private agent with 100+ tools for PC control, file management, OCR screen reading, and safe system automation. Python, LangChain, Ollama, Docker.
- **Enterprise RAG Support Chatbot** — production RAG chatbot over 768K+ support records with semantic search, source context, streaming, and multi-turn memory. LangChain, ChromaDB, Gradio.
- **Gemini Subagents** — open-source manager-and-workers agent orchestration skill. https://github.com/taherfarg/claude-antigravity-subagents
- **Arabic Legal Document OCR** — GPU-enabled OCR pipeline for scanned Arabic legal documents with PDF batching and bilingual prompts. PyTorch, CUDA, Gemma 3.
- **Traffic Speed & Violation System** — real-time vehicle detection, tracking, perspective-based speed estimation, and automated violation capture. YOLOv8, OpenCV, ByteTrack, Flask.
- **NeurAI Brain Tumor Detection** — MRI classification for glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumors. TensorFlow, Flask.
